 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P3 documents.
Ex.P1 and P-2 are the Seizure mahazars.

Ex.P.3 is the Statement of witness  10. The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined him.

During which PW-1 denied all other suggestions put to him, however statement given by him is marked at Ex.P.3.
 11.
On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that CW-1 being the informant, key and material witnesses did not stepped into the witness box to depose about the incident.
The only witness examined by the prosecution is PW-1 who is a mahazar witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case, who failed to identify the accused and contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
Other witnesses were not secured by the prosecution even after issuance of NBW and proclamation.
Hence, they were dropped from being examined.
Other than the hostile evidence of PW1 there is nothing on record to prove the guilt of the accused.

In the absence of evidence of material witnesses and in view of the available witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1,2 and 5 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
